result.brief: 提出 SALM 无监督嵌入对齐框架，通过结构感知潜空间掩码建模与双矩阵对齐，将局部几何先验注入 CLIP 视觉表征，并扩展为高效自蒸馏 SALM-Self，提升细粒度感知与零样本性能。
result.reason: Unsupervised latent masked modeling and self-distillation to inject fine-grained spatial structure into CLIP's visual representation space, directly a visual representation learning contribution.
